reviews.quote:
Gaby did a beautiful outdoor family photo shoot for our extended family (6 adults, a baby, and a toddler). We were really happy with both the photos and the overall experience, highly recommend her!

The experience: The photoshoot felt very relaxed and natural. Rather than being prescriptive about each pose or backdrop, Gaby was super easygoing and followed the children’s lead as well as what we were interested in capturing. She had a great eye for the candid interactions that made the photos feel genuine, and made everyone feel at ease. We all had fun with it and there was not a moment of stress or rush. Gaby assured us that a one-hour session would be plenty of time, and she was right.

The photos: We loved the photo gallery! Gaby captured so many wonderful candid moments with the children and a good mix of large family portraits and smaller group shots. The outdoor backdrops looked beautiful and natural and the photos did not feel over-edited. Because the photos were taken so naturally, everyone looked relaxed and authentic, unlike other shoots I've done that felt more staged or awkwardly posed.

Working with Gaby: Gaby was wonderful to work with. She was incredibly responsive (her email replies were always very quick), super flexible, and delivered the full gallery within a week. Her pricing was very reasonable and we were pleased with the value we got.
reviews.name: Lisa Fan
